name: report-form
title: Report form
description: Report a post, a listing or a user: a short list of reasons, a detail box that opens when it helps, and clear words on what happens next.
docs: Give it reasons ({ id, label, description, requiresDetail }), the subject being reported ({ kind, title, byline }) and onSubmit, which receives { reasonId, detail, block }; return a promise and the button shows it is working, and if it rejects the form stays and says so. A reason with requiresDetail opens a text box with a counter (maxDetail, default 500) and Send waits for minDetail characters (default 10); the line beside Send says what is missing. blockOption adds an 'Also block this user' checkbox, unticked, with your own words if you pass them. After a successful send a confirmation replaces the form, is announced politely and takes the focus; onDone adds its button, onCancel the Cancel button. value, defaultValue and onValueChange hold a draft ({ reasonId, detail, block }). In a Dialog, pass your DialogHeader as header so its title names the dialog; it stays in the page, unseen, after the report is sent, so the dialog keeps its name. In a Dialog that is shorter than the form, the subject, reasons and note scroll between the heading and the Send row, which both stay in view (the form is capped at the screen height less the dialog's margin and its default padding; elsewhere, give it a max-height with className and it scrolls the same way). labels translates the words.
